svg.title: Ice melting 3D | random initial condition
svg.desc: Known input/setup schematic only; three samples. No predicted or evolved solution fields.

g.text: Varying: Initial ellipsoid center, three semiaxes and 3D orientation
Fixed: Cube, material parameters and melting drive; time 0-5 s
Ice; the surrounding phase is water
BC: Closed interactions; no exchange with the exterior of the cube.
Physics: Driven Allen-Cahn melting -> phase field phi(x,y,z,t).
Condition: Initial phase volume -> 3D patch tokens -> shared space-time queries.
Setup only. Same orthographic view; no predicted evolution or temperature field.
